Posted by Darrin Black 22 pm Sentiment for Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)
Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) institutional sentiment decreased to 0.67 in Q3 2018 . Its down -0.04, from 0.71 in 2018Q2. The ratio dropped, as 728 institutional investors increased or opened new equity positions, while 1084 sold and trimmed stakes in Apple Inc. The institutional investors in our partner’s database now have: 2.68 billion shares, down from 2.77 billion shares in 2018Q2. Also, the number of institutional investors holding Apple Inc in their top 10 equity positions increased from 934 to 1004 for an increase of 70. Sold All: 54 Reduced: 1030 Increased: 577 New Position: 151.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $787.61 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 13.74 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
The stock increased 0.05% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $166.52. About 32.67 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 0.17% since February 2, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.17% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $4.21 earnings per share, up 8.23 % or $0.32 from last year’s $3.89 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $19.91B for 9.89 P/E if the $4.21 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.91 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 44.67 % EPS growth.
